description: A small four-point living soul spark held within an open circular seal, with one clear dot in its center. The ring is the vessel and the spark is the possessing mage. No tongues of fire. One isolated game UI badge, readable at 18 pixels. Refined crisp pixel art matching a warm medieval tactical game UI. Bronze outer shape, warm ivory inner light, three or four flat colors, strong simple silhouette and open negative spaces, no gradient glow. Transparent background, centered complete icon with 6 pixel margin. No lettering, no border panel, no background, no character, no flames, no burning sign.
